lines.text: Your build pipeline can now run exactly the code you approved.
A tag like v4 can be moved later, so a hacked action could slip bad code into your pipeline.
lines.title: The old risk

lines.text: The lockfile records exact commits, including dependencies inside other actions.
lines.title: How it works

lines.text: Dependabot updates the lockfile in the same pull request, so the two stay in sync.
lines.title: Staying current

lines.text: Admins can require lockfiles for an enterprise, an organization, or a repository.
lines.title: Governance

lines.text: A lockfile guarantees which code runs, not that the code is safe. Review before locking.
lines.title: Takeaways
